name: Sidereal-Tombolo
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a binary sunset, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
For traders, helium-3 alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
